mapper.select: select s.admin_user_id, u.admin_status, u.permission_version, s.expires_time, s.revoked_time from admin_access_sessions s join admin_users u on u.admin_user_id = s.admin_user_id and u.is_delete = 0 where s.token_id = #{tokenId}::uuid and s.is_delete = 0 limit 1

select distinct p.permission_code from admin_user_roles ur join admin_roles r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.is_delete = 0 and r.role_status = 'ACTIVE' join admin_role_permissions rp on rp.role_id = ur.role_id and rp.is_delete = 0 join admin_permissions p on p.permission_id = rp.permission_id and p.is_delete = 0 and p.permission_status = 'ACTIVE' where ur.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} and ur.is_delete = 0 order by p.permission_code
mapper.update: update admin_access_sessions set revoked_time = #{revokedTime}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} where token_id = #{tokenId}::uuid and admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} and revoked_time is null and is_delete = 0
